doc: GATO's fight before the first A (saves/battle_re/gato_wait.*): the field in front of GATO with his song at its last box, Battle Mode on Wait -- recipes from power-on (fx_a_battle_gato_press_action) plus the capture's documented WRAM pokes (env PEEK_POKE on a 0-frame peek of the recipe).

fixtures.doc: GATO's last box with Battle Mode on Wait ($2990 = 84; the capture is gato_press_action.state with that byte): one more A boots the fight. The play clock $0400-$0405 is set to the capture's (8:28, which the X menu's TIME prints and the menu checks pin); everything else, the sound processor included, is the recipe's.

gato_wait with tools/battle_ab.py pokes_for([0]) applied (Crono solo, every single tech learned, MP 99) -- what battle_ab.run writes for the port. The play clock $0400-$0405 is set to the capture's; everything else is the recipe's.
